script.problem: Moment 3's passage 2 Chronicles 35:23-25 doesn't include a verse that names Megiddo in the lessons.

terra.problem: The last moment cites 2 Chronicles 35:23–25, which says Josiah was wounded at Megiddo and taken to Jerusalem, where he died. It does not say his body was carried from Megiddo. Revise the moment to match Chronicles; 2 Kings 23:29–30 describes Neco killing Josiah at Megiddo and his body being carried from there. The line could also clarify that Chronicles places his death in Jerusalem.
“Lamented” may be difficult for a 5th-grade reader. Use “mourned” or “grieved” instead.
